name: microsoft-teams
title: Microsoft Teams
description: Manage your Microsoft Teams presence and status message. Search for people and chats, open conversations, and start calls.
author: sven

commands.name: findUser
commands.title: Find User
commands.subtitle: Microsoft Teams
commands.description: Find a user and open a chat.

commands.name: setStatus
commands.title: Set Status
commands.subtitle: Microsoft Teams
commands.description: Set your Microsoft Teams status message (and optionally your presence).

tools.name: search-users
tools.title: Search Users
tools.description: Searches Microsoft Teams users by name or email address.

tools.name: search-chats
tools.title: Search Chats
tools.description: Searches Microsoft Teams chats by title, participant, or bot name.

tools.name: get-presence
tools.title: Get User Presence
tools.description: Gets another user's Microsoft Teams presence using their Microsoft Graph user ID.

tools.name: get-current-presence
tools.title: Get Current Presence
tools.description: Gets the signed-in user's current Microsoft Teams presence.

tools.name: set-presence
tools.title: Set Presence
tools.description: Sets or clears the current user's Microsoft Teams presence.

tools.name: set-status
tools.title: Set Status Message
tools.description: Sets the current user's Microsoft Teams status message.

tools.name: clear-status
tools.title: Clear Status Message
tools.description: Clears the current user's Microsoft Teams status message.

tools.name: get-current-user
tools.title: Get Current User
tools.description: Gets the signed-in Microsoft Teams user's profile.

tools.name: list-recent-chats
tools.title: List Recent Chats
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's most recently active Microsoft Teams chats.

tools.name: get-chat-messages
tools.title: Get Chat Messages
tools.description: Gets recent messages from a Microsoft Teams chat.

tools.name: create-chat-link
tools.title: Create Chat Link
tools.description: Creates a Microsoft Teams deep link for a new chat, optionally with draft text.

tools.name: create-call-link
tools.title: Create Call Link
tools.description: Creates a Microsoft Teams deep link for an audio or video call.

preferences.name: urlTarget
preferences.title: Open in
preferences.description: Where to open objects: In the Teams web app or the desktop app?
